evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Successful and smooth performance
criteria.definition: Perceiving oneself as completing tasks successfully, excelling and handling tasks smoothly.
criteria.high_evidence: Describes effective, successful or especially capable performance in ordinary undertaken tasks.
criteria.low_evidence: Describes ineffective, unsuccessful or awkward performance even on manageable tasks.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Hours worked, prompt starting and willingness to persist are C4/C5 content unless successful handling is also expressed. One completed output under external help is not general competence; explicit ordinary performance remains assessable.

criteria.label: Assurance and perceived contribution
criteria.definition: Being sure of one’s ground and believing one has something to contribute.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels well grounded in own view or recognizes useful value in own contribution.
criteria.low_evidence: Doubts own footing or describes having little to contribute.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. These are related but not interchangeable subcontents. Assertive volume or sociability alone is insufficient. Retain literal little-to-contribute content even without a statement of shyness; contradictory assurance/contribution needs a qualified or mixed grade.

criteria.label: Solutions and practical knowhow
criteria.definition: Devising good solutions and knowing how to get things done.
criteria.high_evidence: Reports workable solutions and a practical grasp of how to achieve an everyday result.
criteria.low_evidence: Lacks useful solutions or does not know how to get a manageable task done.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Not identical to enjoying abstract complexity (O5), being organized (C2), or making effort (C4). Specific unavailable information or specialist inexperience alone is ambiguous.

criteria.label: Judgment, understanding and consequences
criteria.definition: Accurately judging situations, understanding things and seeing consequences.
criteria.high_evidence: Understands ordinary information and correctly grasps situations or likely consequences.
criteria.low_evidence: Misjudges situations, does not understand things, or misses foreseeable consequences.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. C6 impulsive style can overlap but acting quickly alone is not misunderstanding. Do not infer actual low intelligence or poor experimental compliance from a coherent description of difficulty.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent portrayed anxiety, difficulty, social awkwardness or antagonism is distinct from actual task/format failure.
One-off constraints alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence remains assessable.

Perceived competence includes successful performance, being sure of one’s ground, contribution, practical solutions and sound understanding/judgment. Do not reduce the target to diligence, ambition or task initiation. Self-report is not an objective ability test.
Score literal item-grounded content rather than politeness, moral worth, verbosity or apparent helpfulness.
